:::: {#hero-heading}
I'm a Professor in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University. I currently serve as the Director of Graduate Studies and as an Associate Editor at *Political Analysis*. My research has appeared in the *American Political Science Review*, the *American Journal of Political Science*, *Political Analysis*, and other peer-reviewed journals. I teach courses in American politics, comparative politics, and political methodology.

::::
